design.name: monthly_sector_global70
design.priority_reason: First direction declared during this audit: closest to permitted own-industry relative leadership and has a frozen absolute/relative same-availability control. Priority is not based on returns.
design.claim: Joint scope-and-dose sensitivity of already defined sector occupancy. It does not identify the isolated causal contribution of scope versus dose, and is not a new factor.
design.source_data: Reuse the frozen 35 arrays and META from monthly_sector_occupancy70; verify byte equality, all 27 inherited arrays, cached feature masks/ranks, and six source review bindings before training. No feature recomputation, new constituents, downloads or author labels.
design.factor_identity: Use exact cached rank_absolute, rank_relative and shared occupancy_available. Six consecutive 42-return blocks from t-294..t-42; own-sector relative versus absolute top-quartile occupancy; original same known-sector direct-stock cohort, minimum 8. ETFs and unknown/missing stocks remain eligible under the old strategy but receive no new factor change.

score_definitions.K: a[core]: already weighted long-momentum core; do not multiply by core_weight again.
score_definitions.c: a[core_weight], original 0.50/0.52 regime coefficient, broadcast only as in the existing cache contract.
score_definitions.S: (a[baseline] - K) / (1 - c): original unweighted auxiliary support. Never infer S from a modified pre-score or final score.
score_definitions.Q_local: Full final score vector from frozen local67 LOCAL_SPEC={id:4,base:incumbent_scope67,mode:local_linear}, after the unchanged original episode calculation exactly once. Keep its native chosen symbols separately for config 0.
score_definitions.h: 0.10 fixed for both new arms; no 0.025 additional grid, sign, window, rank or weight search.
score_definitions.active: shared occupancy_available and F_arm != 0 exactly. Missing or exact zero uses a byte-exact copy of Q_local; no isclose threshold.
score_definitions.Q_arm: Q_local + h * (H - S) on active cells; Q_local elsewhere. Apply to every original eligible name, not the old boundary cohort.
score_definitions.funding: Transfer 10 percentage points from original auxiliary S to H. K and every existing ML/episode contribution stay unchanged; do not multiply Q_local, old models or episode by 0.90. Algebra: Q_local=K+(1-c)*S+A_old, so Q_arm=K+(1-c-h)*S+A_old+h*H. Existing old-model/episode support transfers inside A_old stay as before.
score_definitions.budget_check: With c<=0.52 and inherited combined old model/episode allocation<=0.10, conservative remaining original support is at least 1-0.52-0.10-0.10=0.28. Verify actual inherited allocation contract, not just this bound. Factor h remains manual support, not added leverage.

design.selection: First88 only; configs1..3 eligible against default0. CAGR>=base-1e-12, Sharpe>=base-.05, maxdrawdown>=base-.03, early53/recent35 CAGR>=base-.025. Highest admitted training CAGR; ties within1e-12 lowerID. Freeze all4 before later34. Prefix36->60,60->76,76->88 same rule.
control_interpretation: Config1 versus config0 measures final-selector relaxation on identical scores. Do not promise that these holdings are identical.
Config2 versus config1 measures absolute occupancy at the new scope/dose; config3 versus config2 isolates sector subtraction on the identical availability cohort.
Config2/3 versus old 2.5% boundary counterparts is a joint scope-and-dose comparison, not an isolated scope experiment.
All-missing or all-zero new factors must match config1 score bytes and choices, not necessarily config0 choices.
design.training_selection: Include configs 1,2,3 in first88 admission and selection against config0. Gates: CAGR>=native-1e-12, Sharpe>=native-.05, maximum_drawdown>=native-.03, early53 and recent35 CAGR>=native-.025. Default config0; highest admitted training CAGR, ties within 1e-12 select lower id. Freeze all four and primary before later34; prefix36->60,60->76,76->88 use the same rule.
design.diagnostics: Report matched control comparisons, native versus global0, changed first/second/third selections, all-eligible competition, contribution by early53/recent35/later34 and undo-best1/3 only as diagnostics. Identical frozen orders replay same-close zero, next-open zero and next-open 5bp/side. No outcome-based reranking or next-dose search.
design.implementation_gate: Before actual selection: synthetic tests, exact source35-array/META copies, inherited27 parity, prior six-file actual feature audit binding verified, independent scalar all-cell score/choice audit. Before reporting: independent fixed-unit order replay for all4configs and all3execution models; protected21444 hashes unchanged.
design.protection: Use current manual-run boundary named in boundary. Do not use earlier10/14 or18:02 monitor output hashes as current boundary.
design.objective: Long-momentum-dominant monthly long-only EW3 with latest42 sessions excluded from core; full2016-08-17..2026-09-24 same-close zero-cost CAGR target70%. Honest repeated-development results, no target guarantee.
design.information_set: 88 completed rounds /724 configurations and best local67 full CAGR67.66617372041686% known. Prior sector occupancy narrow boundary results known. No new global config returns or orders computed.
design.execution: Identical frozen choices at same close zero cost, next open zero, next open5bp/side. Monthly fixed adjusted total-return units; no intramonth trading. Current source PIT/estimatedTop32/assumedtheme17 limitations retained.
design.limitations: Joint scope+dose change vs prior boundary experiment cannot isolate separate effects. All periods repeatedly researched; not pristine OOS. Same-close full-data fill idealized. Do not alter frozen observers, rules, prices, memberships or ledgers.
